sentences.text: Potassium acetate is not on FDA's current shortage list as of 2026-10-21; FDA's history shows an earlier shortage first posted on 2019-06-10, since resolved.

Earlier inspections at the same plant were classified VAI, including inspection 1006274 ending 2017-03-17 (815 days before posting), inspection 1039547 ending 2018-02-02 (493 days before posting), and inspection 1066469 ending 2018-09-21 (262 days before posting).
The current label for the product names Hospira, Inc. (FEI 1021343) and Pfizer Healthcare India Private Limited (FEI 3008316085) as registered plants.
The best option by rule is to buy from Exela Pharma Sciences, LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today, though its label names no plant we could place.
